cards.card_text: Then some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers start debating Paul, and some of them ask, “What is this babbler trying to say?” BABBLER?
cards.verse_text: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him.
cards.snippet: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him.

cards.card_text: Other philosophers say Paul seems to be advocating foreign gods.
cards.verse_text: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him.
cards.snippet: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him.

cards.card_text: Paul quotes the Lord's words in the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 29:14): "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate." Then Paul calls roll for the wise man, the scribe and the philosopher of this age, and friend, NOBODY answers.
cards.verse_text: Where is the philosopher of this age?
cards.snippet: Where is the philosopher of this age?
